text:
Income Tax Department
Centralized Processing Centre, Bengaluru
Intimation under section 143(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961
Date of issue: 24-09-2026
Assessment Year: 2026-27

Dear Taxpayer,
Your return of income for AY 2026-27 has been processed. A refund of Rs. 12,340 has been determined and will be credited to your pre-validated bank account.
If there is a difference between the income you returned and the income computed under section 143(1), the details are given in the attached computation.
If you disagree, you can file a rectification request after logging in to the e-Filing portal https://www.incometax.gov.in.
For queries call 1800 103 0025 or 1800 419 0025.
This is a system generated intimation and does not require a signature.
notes: Written by us from the public template or description at source_url for the false-positive hunt (2026-09-30). Names, numbers and references are placeholders; official contacts are the ones the organisation publishes. Not a verbatim copy of a real message.
